text.en: Most reviewers praise groomers Haley and Amanda for their friendly demeanor, clear communication, and attentive approach. Clients appreciate that staff work collaboratively and treat pets with genuine kindness without making owners feel judged. One reviewer expressed dissatisfaction with staff effort regarding their parents' dog.

Pet parents generally report satisfying styling outcomes, noting that dogs return with neat breed-specific trims, clean coats, and trimmed nails. Owners of standard poodles highlight well-shaped cuts completed in reasonable timeframes. Conversely, one client felt the grooming work failed to achieve an acceptable look for their pet.

Reviewers emphasize how comfortably pets are handled throughout their visits. Owners of senior dogs and pets with special needs appreciate that groomers take extra time to keep them relaxed. Multiple clients also note that nervous dogs, including pets typically resistant to nail trims, remain calm and cooperative in the salon.

q.en: Can groomers accommodate elderly or special-needs pets?

a.en: Yes, clients report that staff take extra time to cater gently to senior dogs and pets with specific care requirements.

q.en: How do dogs react to nail trims here?

a.en: Pet parents note that groomers keep nervous dogs relaxed and comfortable during nail clipping and maintenance.
Yes, the salon operates primarily by appointment to ensure dedicated time for each pet's service.
